en.title: New menu development with a cooking mate! New menu naming event for Onlygo.
en.description:
Hello, I'm Moon Se-hoon!

Before opening Onlygo's second store,
I was thinking about creating a signature menu that's unique to the second store.
So, with my old cooking mate Mi-jung, I have been busy preparing the new menu.
I really like this gungjung tteokbokki dish (Korean royal court style rice cake), and I'm thinking of putting this on the menu.
But I still can't think of the right name for it...

For those who suggest a good name for us,
we are giving away a meal voucher for Onlygo, so please participate!

Period: March 25-31
How to participate: Comment on this video
Winner Announcement: Announced on April 4th


If you enjoyed today's video, please like, subscribe, and set notifications!

#MoonSehoon #Onlygo #Tteokbokki
